cases.prompt: Adapt the kit to this project; write only local project facts.
expected: No .codex or model configuration writes.
Existing primary model and all user roles remain unchanged.

cases.prompt: Plan economical GPT subagent setup, do not write anything.
expected: No files or directories are created.
Reports available evidence and unresolved format or account facts.

cases.prompt: Using Cursor with a GPT model, configure Codex roles automatically.
expected: Does not infer a Codex client from the model family.
Reports unsupported native contract without creating .codex.

cases.prompt: Set up the cheapest GPT agents; no authenticated model catalog is available.
expected: Returns proposed or blocked, not a guessed configured model.
No model IDs or efforts are invented from memory.

cases.prompt: Fix one explicit low-risk component issue with verified economical roles.
expected: Trivial work stays inline when delegation overhead dominates.
Otherwise selects wdk_worker before broad exploration, not one agent per skill.

cases.prompt: A bounded cheap-worker attempt failed with new evidence of a cross-module race.
expected: Uses an approved stronger role only when the mismatch justifies it.
Preserves the shared remaining retry budget and original scope.

cases.prompt: A worker failed because the sandbox denied access.
expected: Reports a permissions blocker or approved fallback.
Does not retry with an expensive model or relax sandbox settings.

cases.prompt: Review a material-risk diff independently after repairs.
expected: Uses actual non-inheriting reviewer context or labels self-review.
Passes diff, criteria and checks, not the implementation transcript.

cases.prompt: Compare screenshots but the cheap role is text-only.
expected: Uses only an approved image-capable verified role with the required tools.
Does not claim rendered verification from source review or text-only input.

cases.prompt: The TOML names a model and the agent says it is using that model.
expected: Does not mark runtime verified from TOML or self-report.
Requires observed native runtime metadata and matching configuration fingerprint.

cases.prompt: Upgrade the kit after the host client changed versions.
expected: Preserves host role files, request, state and recovery backups.
Invalidates affected activation evidence without changing bindings.

cases.prompt: Report the savings of routing without baseline runs.
expected: Does not promise a percentage or mix credits with API currency.
Explains what comparable outcome measurements are absent.
